datasets.name: SRSLM (Satellite Remote Sensing Landslide Mapping) dataset
datasets.verbatim: A satellite remote sensing landslide mapping (SRSLM) dataset comprising 25 study areas is provided to validate the effectiveness and robustness of CICRL-FLM.

datasets.name: Bijie benchmark landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: Through extensive experimental tests and reliable inference analyzes on both our SRSLM and the publicly available Bijie benchmark landslide dataset

datasets.name: Global landslide susceptibility map
datasets.verbatim: This map is produced using a heuristic fuzzy overlay modeling approach with the combination of data from five explanatory variables, which are slopes, faults, geology, forest loss, and road networks, to visualize the distribution of landslide-prone areas across the globe (Stanley and Kirschbaum 2017).

datasets.name: Mesetas dataset
datasets.verbatim: Mesetas dataset is composed of high-resolution PlanetScope images (3m) collected in the eastern foothills of the Colombian Eastern Cordillera on 5th January 2020 to 12th February 2020 (Fang et al. 2024)

methods.name: CICRL-FLM (counterfactual inference causal representation learning network for fine-grained landslide mapping)
methods.summary: A deep learning network for landslide mapping that integrates a U-shaped structure (CRT-SwinUNS) with attention blocks (SCMC-AB) and a counterfactual causal inference model (AM-CCR) to mitigate spurious correlations and improve robustness.
methods.source: Chengqiang Zhao, Shijie Chen, Jiashu Zhang & Mingzhe Liu
methods.verbatim: we propose the counterfactual inference causal representation learning network for fine-grained landslide mapping from satellite remote sensing images (CICRL-FLM).

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are mentioned but not linked or provided, and the custom code for the CICRL-FLM method lacks a repository or persistent link.
